points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Exact 1bc8fb6 solver source clean CMake build passed in a restricted network-disabled cfd-bench container; no CFD rerun.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp:28–51 parses solve/export-restart, case/output/restart; solver.cpp:881–919 restores state/step/time but sets both prior BDF states equal to current, so transient restart loses prior history.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: solver/src separates case input/types, CGNS mesh, partition and solver; solver/tools separates plotting, report and synthetic post-processing self-test.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: Inspected source/build for internal solver invocation; none found. No external authorship search performed.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: main.cpp:28–51 parses case/output; :97–120 reads configured case and CGNS mesh and METIS partition, without two-filename-only branching.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: partition.cpp:136–142 calls METIS and builds local halos; main.cpp:110–145 retains global mesh only on root while solve is local. NACA M015 np4/8 last-200 Cd means 0.002290526/0.002290542; source binding null.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: solver.cpp has positivity halving and stable-CFL control; M2 laminar stops with Cd falling 20.6% and metadata falsely says converged. Early source-to-result binding unavailable.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: solver/tools/_selftest exercises synthetic plotting/report pipeline; selected rank comparisons include M015 inviscid np4/8 and Re200 np4/8, but no new CFD rerun.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Curated solver source/report exclude workspace-generated assets; accepted PDF and standalone figures are traced in report/ledger, while result metadata revision is null.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: numerics.hpp implements compressible conservative inviscid and Newtonian-Fourier flux; solver.cpp:330–336 uses pressure gradient for temperature, compromising heat-flux discretization.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: main.cpp:110–130 reads CGNS/partitions on root and scatters local mesh; full mesh retained only on root for output, not replicated to all ranks during solve.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: solver.cpp:286–350 reconstructs face states, evaluates Rusanov and opposing owner/neighbor fluxes; pressure-gradient-as-temperature defect affects viscous flux.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: solver.cpp:306 and numerics.hpp implement Rusanov flux; report identifies this dissipative choice and notes shock limitations.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: solver.cpp:799–819 outputs zero no-slip boundary velocities; Re20 selected surface has 100 rows all u=v=0. Heat gradient and surface Cf direction defects documented separately.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: solver.cpp:172–204 computes and exchanges Green–Gauss gradients; :286–306 reconstructs primitive face values with positivity fallback.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: solver.cpp:207 onward applies Barth for steady viscous and Venkatakrishnan for inviscid/transient; :1014–1019 refreshes transient limiter once per physical step, not each inner iteration.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: solver.cpp:190–204 stores rho/u/v/p gradients; :330–336 uses pressure gradient as temperature for heat flux. :782–794 uses full traction for force split. No-slip row sets u=v=0 :808–811, then Cf :820–826 falls back to x direction rather than wall tangent.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: All selected steady metadata records inner_target_converged_fraction=0; outer residual/plateau statuses must be independently checked, and M2 laminar Cd is still falling at stop.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: solver.cpp:1014–1021 recomputes gradients each inner sweep but freezes limiter after first; measured target is lagged-limiter residual, and fully refreshed strict miss count is unknown. Raw lift FFT yields St0.14 across t>=100/150/200.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS and local halo implemented; M015 inviscid np4/8 last-200 mean Cd 0.002290526/0.002290542, Cl0.000415197/0.000411708. Re200 rank study is transient, no extra steady cylinder comparison.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Prior structural examiner pass does not prove physics. M2 laminar metadata says converged despite Cd falling 20.6% in last62 rows; transient restart loses preceding state.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Prior eight-case/report examiner validator passed; current manager gates check structure and index, not physical convergence.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Three inviscid plateaus are justified by bounded late residuals and stable Cl/Cd; M2 laminar Cd falls 20.6% in final 62 rows while status claims converged.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Re20 selected Cd≈1.997 is plausible and Re200 FFT St≈0.14 is stable by time window; M2 laminar Cd declines 20.6% immediately before reported convergence.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: PDF p10 Re20 contours are compressed into strips and late force detail is hidden by startup; p10 Re200 late force oscillations unreadable while p11 wake zoom is visible.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report.tex:501–509 discloses plateau acceptance, supported for inviscid cases. It labels M2 laminar converged despite changing drag and shows compressed cylinder plots.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Accepted PDF and standalone figure manifests/hashes are recorded; case metadata git_revision=null and selected M2 result predates final source, so exact producing revision unbound.

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Exact 1bc8fb6 clean build passed; CLI supports restart but solver.cpp:881–919 restores step/time/current state and sets both prior BDF states equal, losing previous physical history on transient restart.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: main.cpp:110–130 imports CGNS/METIS on rank0 and scatters local meshes; global mesh remains only on root for output, not every rank.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: solver.cpp:172–204,286–350 reconstructs states, applies Rusanov and conservative face flux, with ghost boundaries; temperature gradient slot defect documented under viscous.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: Green–Gauss primitive reconstruction and Barth/Venkat limiters implemented in solver.cpp:172–306; transient limiter frozen within inner solve, and all steady inner targets missed.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: solver.cpp:190–204 stores rho/u/v/p gradients, but :330–336 uses pressure slot3 as temperature gradient; directional correction replaces only connecting-direction projection. :782–794 integrates full traction; no-slip surface Cf :808–826 uses fixed x direction because boundary u=v=0, not the wall tangent.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: LU-SGS/BDF2 implementation exists; all selected steady metadata reports every inner target missed. Transient solver.cpp:1014–1021 refreshes gradients but freezes limiter during inner solve; zero recorded misses do not prove fully refreshed nonlinear target. Source/run linkage unproven.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: METIS local partition, neighbor exchanges and reductions implemented; NACA M015 np4/8 last-200 Cd means 0.002290526/0.002290542, Cl0.000415197/0.000411708. Cylinder comparison is Re200 transient; no separate steady cylinder comparison established.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: Three inviscid cases have bounded stable documented force plateaus despite short residual reductions. M2 laminar stops at step627 while last62 Cd values fall 20.6%; Re20 raw Cd≈1.997 is plausible and Re200 FFT St≈0.14, but figure floors are deficient.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: Accepted PDF p10 Re20 Mach/pressure fields collapse to strips and force tail is startup dominated; p10 Re200 force plot lacks readable late lift/drag, while p11 wake zoom is readable. M2 laminar is called converged despite declining force.

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: Case/mesh/partition/solver and plotting tools separated, but numerical implementation remains 2D and RANS/EOS extensions not demonstrated.

flags.flag: metadata.json marks incomplete or failed runs as successful final results
flags.evidence: Prior flag relied solely on inviscid outer residual reductions 2.509,2.383,-0.040. TASK.md:172 allows a clearly justified stable force/residual plateau. For M015/M080/M200 inviscid the last-10% residual half-means are 1.460e-5→1.433e-5, 1.01311e-6→1.01318e-6, 1.32099e-4→1.31991e-4; Cd half-means 0.00228491→0.00228905, 0.00928821490→0.00928821492, 0.092531847→0.092531879; Cl half-means 0.00041351→0.00041146, 0.000435354436→0.000435354431, -0.000174608→-0.000174055. The report explicitly discloses plateau criteria; residual-order shortfalls alone do not prove false success. Re200 FFT peak0.14 across t>=100,150,200, with nonzero oscillation; strict refreshed-limiter misses remain unknown. Other DQ triggers remain under review.
